description: What things cost, and no total

participation.context: Wrote the rates he already pays and did not count the box.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Her notch, her ink, her board. Not in the room.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

relations.note: her rates, not a new bargain

story.body: You set down the loaf, the ink, the sixpence, and the board, and you did not open a total. The twenty pound stayed out of the list.

relations.note: her rates, not a new bargain

title: Wrote the loaf, the ink, the sixpence, and the board
